name: NGC 4866 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4866, a nearly edge-on lenticular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc4866-hubble
story: Seen almost edge-on, NGC 4866 shows the flat disk of a lenticular galaxy, a form between spirals and ellipticals. Faint dust lanes trace across it, hiding part of its light.

claims.text: It is seen almost edge-on, showing its disk
Lenticulars lie between spirals and ellipticals
Faint dust lanes cross the galaxy
